title: 原子干涉重力儀
summary: 以銣-87 自由落體原子干涉重力儀為對象，從 π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列與相位 Δφ = k_eff·g·T² 出發，建置啁啾讀出、雷射與真空系統、反射鏡隔振與傾斜控制，再以 k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐校正建立誤差預算，最後透過古典加速度計混合與落體式重力儀比對完成微伽等級的驗收。
summaryEn: Taking a rubidium-87 free-fall atom-interferometer gravimeter as the object, this course starts from the π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence and the phase Δφ = k_eff·g·T², builds the chirp readout, laser and vacuum systems, mirror vibration isolation and tilt control, establishes an error budget through k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tidal corrections, and closes with classical-accelerometer hybridization and comparison against a free-fall gravimeter for microgal-level acceptance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 銣-87 重力儀設計核對：λ = 780.24 nm，k_eff = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m，T = 100 ms，比例因子 k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²)，g = 9.81 m/s² 的干涉相位 1.58×10⁶ rad；都卜勒補償啁啾 α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s，參考振盪器 1×10⁻⁹ 的準確度對應約 1 µGal。靈敏度：每次量測相位雜訊 10 mrad → δg = 6.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz → 4.4 µGal/√Hz；平均 1000 s → 0.14 µGal。機械：傾斜 50 µrad 的誤差 g·θ²/2 = 1.2 µGal；原子雲水平速度 1 mm/s 的科氏加速度 2Ω_E·v = 14.6 µGal，必須補償。振動：地面雜訊 10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz 在 5 Hz 頻寬內給 0.36 rad，混合修正抑制 30 倍後 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal。準確度表合成 1.8 µGal；與落體式重力儀比對差 1.5 µGal、各 2 µGal 不確定度，En = 0.53。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: Rubidium-87 gravimeter design check: λ = 780.24 nm, k_eff = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m, T = 100 ms, scale factor k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²), interferometer phase 1.58×10⁶ rad for g = 9.81 m/s²; Doppler-compensating chirp α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s, and a 1×10⁻⁹ reference-oscillator accuracy corresponds to about 1 µGal. Sensitivity: 10 mrad of phase noise per shot → δg = 6.2 µGal; 2 Hz repetition → 4.4 µGal/√Hz; averaging 1000 s → 0.14 µGal. Mechanics: a 50 µrad tilt gives g·θ²/2 = 1.2 µGal; a 1 mm/s horizontal cloud velocity gives a Coriolis acceleration 2Ω_E·v = 14.6 µGal that must be compensated. Vibration: ground noise of 10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz over a 5 Hz bandwidth gives 0.36 rad, reduced 30-fold by hybrid correction to 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal. The accuracy table combines to 1.8 µGal; against a free-fall gravimeter the difference is 1.5 µGal with 2 µGal uncertainties each, En = 0.53. All values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

steps.title: 物質波馬赫—曾德干涉與重力相位：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Matter-wave Mach–Zehnder interferometry and the gravity phase: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」如何決定原子干涉重力儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence” determines the key performance of “Atomic-interferometer gravimeters”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一團冷銣原子在真空中自由落下，三個相隔 T 的雙光子拉曼脈衝扮演物質波的分束器、反射鏡與合束器：第一個 π/2 脈衝把原子分成兩條動量相差 ħk_eff 的路徑，π 脈衝交換兩路，最後的 π/2 脈衝讓它們干涉，干涉結果表現為兩個超精細基態的布居比例。每次脈衝都把雷射相位印在原子上，而雷射相位隨原子位置變化，於是兩條路徑的相位差正比於原子在三個時刻的位置，即 Δφ = k_eff·g·T²。重力儀的「尺」是雷射波長、「鐘」是 T，兩者都可溯源到原子或頻率標準，所以量測是絕對的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cloud of cold rubidium atoms falls freely in vacuum while three two-photon Raman pulses separated by T act as beam splitter, mirror and recombiner for the matter wave: the first π/2 pulse splits the atoms into two paths differing in momentum by ħk_eff, the π pulse swaps them, and the final π/2 pulse makes them interfere, the outcome appearing as the population ratio of the two hyperfine ground states. Each pulse imprints the laser phase on the atoms, and that phase varies with atom position, so the path phase difference is proportional to the atom positions at the three instants, Δφ = k_eff·g·T². The gravimeter's ruler is the laser wavelength and its clock is T, both traceable to atomic or frequency standards, which makes the measurement absolute. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：銣-87 D2 線 λ = 780.24 nm，反向傳播拉曼光束的 k_eff = 2×2π/λ = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m；取 T = 100 ms，比例因子 k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²)，g = 9.81 m/s² 的干涉相位 Δφ = 1.58×10⁶ rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the rubidium-87 D2 line λ = 780.24 nm, counter-propagating Raman beams give k_eff = 2×2π/λ = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m; with T = 100 ms the scale factor is k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²), and g = 9.81 m/s² produces an interferometer phase Δφ = 1.58×10⁶ rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原子干涉重力儀是量原子落下的時間，和落體式重力儀原理相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An atom gravimeter times the atoms' fall, the same principle as a free-fall corner-cube gravimeter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 物質波馬赫—曾德干涉與重力相位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Matter-wave Mach–Zehnder interferometry and the gravity phase: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：銣-87 D2 線 λ = 780.24 nm，反向傳播拉曼光束的 k_eff = 2×2π/λ = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m；取 T = 100 ms，比例因子 k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²)，g = 9.81 m/s² 的干涉相位 Δφ = 1.58×10⁶ rad。若每次量測的相位雜訊為 10 mrad，單次重力解析度 δg = 0.010/1.611×10⁵ = 6.2×10⁻⁸ m/s² = 6.2 µGal（1 µGal = 10⁻⁸ m/s²，約為 g 的 10⁻⁹）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the rubidium-87 D2 line λ = 780.24 nm, counter-propagating Raman beams give k_eff = 2×2π/λ = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m; with T = 100 ms the scale factor is k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²), and g = 9.81 m/s² produces an interferometer phase Δφ = 1.58×10⁶ rad. With 10 mrad of phase noise per shot the single-shot gravity resolution is δg = 0.010/1.611×10⁵ = 6.2×10⁻⁸ m/s² = 6.2 µGal (1 µGal = 10⁻⁸ m/s², about 10⁻⁹ of g). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 T = 10、20、40、80 ms 分別掃描第三個脈衝的相位並記錄干涉條紋，確認條紋週期固定而相位隨 T² 增加；把 T 加倍時條紋相位應增加四倍，偏離 T² 律表示脈衝時序或拉曼光相位有系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the phase of the third pulse at T = 10, 20, 40 and 80 ms and record the fringes, confirming a constant fringe period with phase growing as T²; doubling T should quadruple the phase, and any departure from the T² law indicates a systematic error in pulse timing or Raman phase.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 物質波馬赫—曾德干涉與重力相位：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Matter-wave Mach–Zehnder interferometry and the gravity phase: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 T = 10、20、40、80 ms 分別掃描第三個脈衝的相位並記錄干涉條紋，確認條紋週期固定而相位隨 T² 增加；把 T 加倍時條紋相位應增加四倍，偏離 T² 律表示脈衝時序或拉曼光相位有系統誤差。同時記錄條紋對比，T = 100 ms 時應仍有 30% 以上。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the phase of the third pulse at T = 10, 20, 40 and 80 ms and record the fringes, confirming a constant fringe period with phase growing as T²; doubling T should quadruple the phase, and any departure from the T² law indicates a systematic error in pulse timing or Raman phase. Record fringe contrast at the same time, which should remain above 30% at T = 100 ms. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：拉曼光束未真正反向傳播（同向傳播的拉曼躍遷），k_eff 退化為兩束的波向量差而近乎為零，原子對重力幾乎不敏感，儀器輸出看似穩定卻與 g 無關。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the Raman beams are not truly counter-propagating (co-propagating Raman transition), k_eff collapses to the near-zero difference of the two wavevectors, the atoms become almost insensitive to gravity, and the output looks stable but has nothing to do with g.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: 原子落下時相對於拉曼光的都卜勒頻移以 k_eff·g/(2π) 的速率線性增加，若雙光子頻率差不跟著變，三個脈衝就會相繼失諧。因此兩束拉曼光的頻率差以速率 α 線性啁啾，總相位變為 Δφ = (k_eff·g − 2πα)·T²。掃描 α 並在不同 T 下記錄條紋，所有 T 的條紋在 α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) 處交於同一點，此點與 T 無關，直接給出 g = 2πα₀/k_eff；這個「中心條紋」法把重力量測變成頻率量測，準確度取決於產生啁啾的直接數位合成器所用的參考振盪器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「拉曼頻率啁啾 α 與條紋讀出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: As the atoms fall, their Doppler shift relative to the Raman light grows linearly at k_eff·g/(2π), and unless the two-photon frequency difference follows, the three pulses go progressively off resonance. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 1.611×10⁷×9.81/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「啁啾只是為了讓原子保持共振，對 g 的數值本身沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在 T = 40、60、80、100 ms 下各掃描 α 跨越三個條紋週期，用正弦擬合找出每個 T 的條紋中心，確認四條曲線交於同一 α₀，交點離散應小於 0.05 Hz/s（約 2 µGal）。
原子重力儀是量子儀器，所以不需要與傳統重力儀比對。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

At T = 40, 60, 80 and 100 ms scan α across three fringe periods, locate each fringe centre by sine fitting and confirm that the four curves cross at one α₀ with a scatter below 0.05 Hz/s (about 2 µGal).
Being a quantum instrument, an atom gravimeter does not need comparison with classical gravimeters.
quiz.explanation: 在 T = 40、60、80、100 ms 下各掃描 α 跨越三個條紋週期，用正弦擬合找出每個 T 的條紋中心，確認四條曲線交於同一 α₀，交點離散應小於 0.05 Hz/s（約 2 µGal）；以頻率計數器對照 GPS 馴服鐘驗證合成器的輸出頻率與啁啾斜率，誤差應低於 10⁻⁹。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At T = 40, 60, 80 and 100 ms scan α across three fringe periods, locate each fringe centre by sine fitting and confirm that the four curves cross at one α₀ with a scatter below 0.05 Hz/s (about 2 µGal); verify the synthesizer's output frequency and chirp slope against a GPS-disciplined clock with a frequency counter, with error below 10⁻⁹. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 都卜勒補償啁啾與 g 的讀出：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Doppler-compensating chirp and the readout of g: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拉曼頻率啁啾 α 與條紋讀出」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Raman frequency chirp α and fringe readout” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 合成器的時鐘用的是普通石英振盪器（10⁻⁶ 等級），啁啾速率隨溫度漂移 25 Hz/s，重力讀值每天擺動近 1 mGal，比地球潮汐大一個數量級。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Clocking the synthesizer from an ordinary quartz oscillator (10⁻⁶ class) lets the chirp rate drift by 25 Hz/s with temperature, and the gravity reading swings by nearly 1 mGal per day, an order of magnitude more than Earth tides. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：掃描 α 並在不同 T 下記錄條紋，所有 T 的條紋在 α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) 處交於同一點，此點與 T 無關，直接給出 g = 2πα₀/k_eff；這個「中心條紋」法把重力量測變成頻率量測，準確度取決於產生啁啾的直接數位合成器所用的參考振盪器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Scanning α and recording fringes at several T, all fringes cross at one point α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) that is independent of T, giving g = 2πα₀/k_eff directly; this central-fringe method turns a gravity measurement into a frequency measurement whose accuracy rests on the reference oscillator feeding the direct digital synthesizer that produces the chirp.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「啁啾只是為了讓原子保持共振，對 g 的數值本身沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The chirp merely keeps the atoms resonant and has no influence on the value of g." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雷射、真空與偵測次系統」與「慣性參考鏡的機械設計與傾斜控制」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Laser, vacuum and detection subsystems" and "Mechanical design of the inertial reference mirror and tilt control": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雷射、真空與偵測次系統：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Laser, vacuum and detection subsystems: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相」如何決定原子干涉重力儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “780 nm Raman lasers with the 6.834 GHz phase lock” determines the key performance of “Atomic-interferometer gravimeters”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射系統要提供冷卻光（鎖在 D2 線 F = 2→3' 附近）、回泵光（F = 1→2'）與兩束相位鎖定、頻率相差銣-87 超精細分裂 6.834 GHz 的拉曼光；拉曼光對激發態失諧約 1 GHz，以避免自發輻射。它們常由 1560 nm 光纖雷射倍頻或 780 nm 二極體雷射放大產生，並以飽和吸收穩頻。真空腔是鈦合金或玻璃腔，2D 磁光阱以高通量送原子進 3D 磁光阱，每 0.5 s 裝載約 10⁸ 個原子後釋放約 10⁵–10⁶ 個進入干涉；偵測在落體底部以共振螢光分別讀出 F = 1 與 F = 2 的原子數，取比值得到躍遷機率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The laser system must provide cooling light (locked near the D2 F = 2→3' line), repump light (F = 1→2') and two phase-locked Raman beams whose frequencies differ by the rubidium-87 hyperfine splitting of 6.834 GHz, detuned about 1 GHz from the excited state to avoid spontaneous emission. They are typically produced by frequency-doubling 1560 nm fibre lasers or by amplified 780 nm diode lasers, and stabilised by saturated absorption. The vacuum chamber is a titanium-alloy or glass cell; a 2D MOT feeds a 3D MOT at high flux, loading about 10⁸ atoms every 0.5 s and releasing 10⁵–10⁶ into the interferometer; detection at the bottom of the fall reads the F = 1 and F = 2 populations by resonant fluorescence and takes their ratio as the transition probability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “780 nm Raman lasers with the 6.834 GHz phase lock”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙光子拉比頻率 Ω_eff = Ω₁Ω₂/(2Δ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The two-photon Rabi frequency is Ω_eff = Ω₁Ω₂/(2Δ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拉曼光的功率越高越好，因為脈衝越短對比越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More Raman power is always better because shorter pulses give higher contrast." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 雷射、真空與偵測次系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Laser, vacuum and detection subsystems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “780 nm Raman lasers with the 6.834 GHz phase lock” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙光子拉比頻率 Ω_eff = Ω₁Ω₂/(2Δ)。取單光子失諧 Δ = 2π×1 GHz、Ω₁ = Ω₂ = 2π×10 MHz，Ω_eff = 2π×50 kHz，π 脈衝長度 π/Ω_eff = 10 µs。所需強度由 Ω₁ = Γ√(I/(2I_sat)) 反推（Γ = 2π×6.07 MHz、I_sat = 1.67 mW/cm²）：I = 2I_sat(Ω₁/Γ)² = 2×1.67×(10/6.07)² = 9.1 mW/cm²；直徑 30 mm 的光束（7.07 cm²）每束需約 64 mW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The two-photon Rabi frequency is Ω_eff = Ω₁Ω₂/(2Δ). With a single-photon detuning Δ = 2π×1 GHz and Ω₁ = Ω₂ = 2π×10 MHz, Ω_eff = 2π×50 kHz and a π pulse lasts π/Ω_eff = 10 µs. The required intensity follows from Ω₁ = Γ√(I/(2I_sat)) (Γ = 2π×6.07 MHz, I_sat = 1.67 mW/cm²): I = 2I_sat(Ω₁/Γ)² = 2×1.67×(10/6.07)² = 9.1 mW/cm²; a 30 mm diameter beam (7.07 cm²) needs about 64 mW per Raman beam. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以頻譜分析儀觀察兩束拉曼光的 6.834 GHz 拍頻，確認鎖相後載波內的功率比例高於 90%、鎖相迴路頻寬約 1 MHz；用拉比振盪實驗（改變脈衝長度記錄躍遷機率）量出 Ω_eff，確認 π 脈衝約 10 µs 且 π 脈衝效率高於 90%；以飛行時間法確認原子溫度約 2–3 µK。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe the 6.834 GHz beat between the two Raman beams on a spectrum analyser, confirming more than 90% of the power within the carrier after locking and a lock bandwidth of about 1 MHz; measure Ω_eff with a Rabi-oscillation experiment (transition probability versus pulse length), confirming a π pulse of about 10 µs with efficiency above 90%; confirm an atom temperature of 2–3 µK by time of flight.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 雷射、真空與偵測次系統：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Laser, vacuum and detection subsystems: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “780 nm Raman lasers with the 6.834 GHz phase lock” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以頻譜分析儀觀察兩束拉曼光的 6.834 GHz 拍頻，確認鎖相後載波內的功率比例高於 90%、鎖相迴路頻寬約 1 MHz；用拉比振盪實驗（改變脈衝長度記錄躍遷機率）量出 Ω_eff，確認 π 脈衝約 10 µs 且 π 脈衝效率高於 90%；以飛行時間法確認原子溫度約 2–3 µK。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe the 6.834 GHz beat between the two Raman beams on a spectrum analyser, confirming more than 90% of the power within the carrier after locking and a lock bandwidth of about 1 MHz; measure Ω_eff with a Rabi-oscillation experiment (transition probability versus pulse length), confirming a π pulse of about 10 µs with efficiency above 90%; confirm an atom temperature of 2–3 µK by time of flight. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：拉曼光的單光子失諧只有 200 MHz，自發輻射在三個脈衝中讓 10% 的原子跳出干涉路徑，條紋對比掉到 15%，每次量測的相位雜訊加倍，且產生與功率相關的光位移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single-photon Raman detuning of only 200 MHz lets spontaneous emission knock 10% of the atoms out of the interferometer paths during the three pulses, contrast falls to 15%, the per-shot phase noise doubles and a power-dependent light shift appears.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 系統效應的量測、反轉與修正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」如何決定原子干涉重力儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides” determines the key performance of “Atomic-interferometer gravimeters”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 許多系統相位與 k_eff 的方向無關（交流史塔克光位移、二階季曼位移、射頻相位），而重力相位會隨 k_eff 反號；交替使用 +k_eff 與 −k_eff 兩組拉曼躍遷並取差，就能消去這類項。與方向有關的則需個別評估：地球自轉的科氏力把原子雲的水平速度轉成垂直假加速度；地球潮汐讓 g 以半日週期變化上百微伽，必須用潮汐模型修正或作為儀器正確性的檢驗；大氣壓力與極移也各有 µGal 級貢獻。這些修正讓重力儀從「穩定」走向「準確」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many systematic phases are independent of the direction of k_eff (AC Stark light shifts, second-order Zeeman shift, RF phases) while the gravity phase changes sign with k_eff; alternating +k_eff and −k_eff Raman transitions and taking the difference cancels such terms. Direction-dependent effects must be evaluated individually: the Coriolis force from Earth's rotation converts the cloud's horizontal velocity into a false vertical acceleration; Earth tides change g by more than a hundred microgals with a semidiurnal period and must be corrected with a tidal model or used as a check of the instrument; atmospheric pressure and polar motion each contribute at the microgal level too. These corrections move the gravimeter from stable to accurate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：科氏加速度 a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥，Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s：原子雲水平速度 v_⊥ = 1 mm/s 時 a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal，2 mm/s 時 29 µGal，遠大於目標準確度，所以要用反射鏡的微旋轉（以地球自轉速率反向轉動鏡面）或東西向速度選擇來補償。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Coriolis acceleration is a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥ with Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s: a cloud horizontal velocity v_⊥ = 1 mm/s gives a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal, and 2 mm/s gives 29 µGal, far above the target accuracy, so it is compensated by counter-rotating the mirror at Earth's rotation rate or by east–west velocity selection.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「絕對重力儀不需要任何修正，因為它直接量 g。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An absolute gravimeter needs no corrections because it measures g directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 系統效應的量測、反轉與修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：科氏加速度 a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥，Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s：原子雲水平速度 v_⊥ = 1 mm/s 時 a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal，2 mm/s 時 29 µGal，遠大於目標準確度，所以要用反射鏡的微旋轉（以地球自轉速率反向轉動鏡面）或東西向速度選擇來補償。固體潮汐的峰對峰幅度可達 200–300 µGal，重力儀必須能在 24 小時內以 µGal 級殘差重現潮汐曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Coriolis acceleration is a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥ with Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s: a cloud horizontal velocity v_⊥ = 1 mm/s gives a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal, and 2 mm/s gives 29 µGal, far above the target accuracy, so it is compensated by counter-rotating the mirror at Earth's rotation rate or by east–west velocity selection. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure continuously for 48 hours alternating ±k_eff, subtract the tidal model (with ocean loading) and the pressure correction from the mean and plot the residual, whose standard deviation should be within a few microgals with no semidiurnal remnant; deliberately change the cloud's horizontal velocity by ±1 mm/s (by unbalancing MOT release power), measure the change in g and compare with 2Ω_E·v_⊥ to confirm that the Coriolis compensation works.

quiz.question: 依「系統效應的量測、反轉與修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects", which statement holds?
options: 科氏加速度 a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥，Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s：原子雲水平速度 v_⊥ = 1 mm/s 時 a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal，2 mm/s 時 29 µGal，遠大於目標準確度，所以要用反射鏡的微旋轉（以地球自轉速率反向轉動鏡面）或東西向速度選擇來補償。
原子重力儀是量子儀器，所以不需要與傳統重力儀比對。
啁啾只是為了讓原子保持共振，對 g 的數值本身沒有影響。
optionsEn: The Coriolis acceleration is a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥ with Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s: a cloud horizontal velocity v_⊥ = 1 mm/s gives a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal, and 2 mm/s gives 29 µGal, far above the target accuracy, so it is compensated by counter-rotating the mirror at Earth's rotation rate or by east–west velocity selection.
Being a quantum instrument, an atom gravimeter does not need comparison with classical gravimeters.
The chirp merely keeps the atoms resonant and has no influence on the value of g.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統效應的量測、反轉與修正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 連續 48 小時以 ±k_eff 交替量測，把平均值減去潮汐模型（含海洋負荷）與氣壓修正後畫殘差，殘差標準差應在數 µGal 內且無半日週期殘留；把原子雲的水平速度刻意改變 ±1 mm/s（調整磁光阱釋放時的光功率平衡），量 g 的變化並與 2Ω_E·v_⊥ 比較，確認科氏補償有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure continuously for 48 hours alternating ±k_eff, subtract the tidal model (with ocean loading) and the pressure correction from the mean and plot the residual, whose standard deviation should be within a few microgals with no semidiurnal remnant; deliberately change the cloud's horizontal velocity by ±1 mm/s (by unbalancing MOT release power), measure the change in g and compare with 2Ω_E·v_⊥ to confirm that the Coriolis compensation works. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只用單一 k_eff 方向量測，拉曼光功率隨溫度變化使交流史塔克位移漂移，重力讀值出現 20 µGal 的日變化，被誤判為地下水位變動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring with a single k_eff direction lets the AC Stark shift drift as Raman power follows temperature, the gravity reading shows a 20 µGal daily variation, and it is misread as groundwater-level change.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
連續 48 小時以 ±k_eff 交替量測，把平均值減去潮汐模型（含海洋負荷）與氣壓修正後畫殘差，殘差標準差應在數 µGal 內且無半日週期殘留。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Measure continuously for 48 hours alternating ±k_eff, subtract the tidal model (with ocean loading) and the pressure correction from the mean and plot the residual, whose standard deviation should be within a few microgals with no semidiurnal remnant.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure continuously for 48 hours alternating ±k_eff, subtract the tidal model (with ocean loading) and the pressure correction from the mean and plot the residual, whose standard deviation should be within a few microgals with no semidiurnal remnant; deliberately change the cloud's horizontal velocity by ±1 mm/s (by unbalancing MOT release power), measure the change in g and compare with 2Ω_E·v_⊥ to confirm that the Coriolis compensation works. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統效應的量測、反轉與修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只用單一 k_eff 方向量測，拉曼光功率隨溫度變化使交流史塔克位移漂移，重力讀值出現 20 µGal 的日變化，被誤判為地下水位變動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring with a single k_eff direction lets the AC Stark shift drift as Raman power follows temperature, the gravity reading shows a 20 µGal daily variation, and it is misread as groundwater-level change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These corrections move the gravimeter from stable to accurate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「絕對重力儀不需要任何修正，因為它直接量 g。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sensitivity, noise budget and accuracy budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」如何決定原子干涉重力儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table” determines the key performance of “Atomic-interferometer gravimeters”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力儀有兩張預算表。靈敏度表列出每次量測的相位雜訊來源：量子投影雜訊（由原子數與條紋對比決定）、殘餘振動、偵測雜訊、拉曼雷射相位雜訊；合成後除以比例因子得到每次量測的 µGal 數，再除以重複率的平方根得到每 √Hz 的靈敏度，最後隨 √τ 平均。準確度表列出不隨平均縮小的偏差：科氏、波前像差、雙光子光位移、二階季曼、傾斜、儀器自重力與參考高度修正；每項以估計值加不確定度列出，均方根合成即儀器的準確度。兩張表分開看，才不會把「穩定」誤當「準確」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gravimeter carries two budget tables. The sensitivity table lists per-shot phase-noise sources: quantum projection noise (set by atom number and fringe contrast), residual vibration, detection noise and Raman-laser phase noise; their combination divided by the scale factor gives microgals per shot, dividing by the square root of the repetition rate gives the sensitivity per √Hz, and the result averages down as √τ. The accuracy table lists biases that do not average away: Coriolis, wavefront aberration, two-photon light shift, second-order Zeeman, tilt, instrument self-gravity and the reference-height correction; each is listed as an estimate with an uncertainty, and their root-sum-square is the instrument's accuracy. Keeping the tables separate prevents mistaking stable for accurate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量子投影雜訊 δφ = 1/(C√N)，C = 0.5、N = 10⁵ 時 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal；殘餘振動（混合修正後）10 µGal、偵測 3 µGal，每次量測合成 √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz 給 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz，平均 1000 s 後 0.25 µGal。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Quantum projection noise δφ = 1/(C√N) with C = 0.5 and N = 10⁵ is 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal; residual vibration (after hybrid correction) 10 µGal and detection 3 µGal combine to √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal per shot; at 2 Hz repetition that is 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz, averaging to 0.25 µGal after 1000 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均時間夠長，所有誤差都會被平均掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Given enough averaging time, every error averages away." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensitivity, noise budget and accuracy budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量子投影雜訊 δφ = 1/(C√N)，C = 0.5、N = 10⁵ 時 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal；殘餘振動（混合修正後）10 µGal、偵測 3 µGal，每次量測合成 √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz 給 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz，平均 1000 s 後 0.25 µGal。準確度表（教學假設）：科氏 0.5、波前 1.5、雙光子光位移 0.5、季曼 0.3、傾斜 0.3、自重力 0.5 µGal，合成 √(0.25 + 2.25 + 0.25 + 0.09 + 0.09 + 0.25) = 1.8 µGal。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Quantum projection noise δφ = 1/(C√N) with C = 0.5 and N = 10⁵ is 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal; residual vibration (after hybrid correction) 10 µGal and detection 3 µGal combine to √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal per shot; at 2 Hz repetition that is 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz, averaging to 0.25 µGal after 1000 s. Accuracy table (teaching assumptions): Coriolis 0.5, wavefront 1.5, two-photon light shift 0.5, Zeeman 0.3, tilt 0.3, self-gravity 0.5 µGal, combining to √(0.25 + 2.25 + 0.25 + 0.09 + 0.09 + 0.25) = 1.8 µGal. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄連續 10⁴ 次量測並計算艾倫偏差，確認斜率 −1/2 且 1 s 的值與預算表的 7.9 µGal/√Hz 一致；在深夜地面安靜時段重做，若雜訊下降則振動項仍為主導；把原子數減半，確認雜訊只小幅上升，證明量子投影雜訊不是瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record 10⁴ consecutive shots and compute the Allan deviation, confirming a −1/2 slope and a 1 s value matching the budget's 7.9 µGal/√Hz; repeat during quiet night hours, and if the noise drops the vibration term still dominates; halve the atom number and confirm only a small noise increase, proving that quantum projection noise is not the bottleneck.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 量子投影雜訊 δφ = 1/(C√N)，C = 0.5、N = 10⁵ 時 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal；殘餘振動（混合修正後）10 µGal、偵測 3 µGal，每次量測合成 √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz 給 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz，平均 1000 s 後 0.25 µGal。準確度表（教學假設）：科氏 0.5、波前 1.5、雙光子光位移 0.5、季曼 0.3、傾斜 0.3、自重力 0.5 µGal，合成 √(0.25 + 2.25 + 0.25 + 0.09 + 0.09 + 0.25) = 1.8 µGal。
knowledge.textEn: Quantum projection noise δφ = 1/(C√N) with C = 0.5 and N = 10⁵ is 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal; residual vibration (after hybrid correction) 10 µGal and detection 3 µGal combine to √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal per shot; at 2 Hz repetition that is 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz, averaging to 0.25 µGal after 1000 s. Accuracy table (teaching assumptions): Coriolis 0.5, wavefront 1.5, two-photon light shift 0.5, Zeeman 0.3, tilt 0.3, self-gravity 0.5 µGal, combining to √(0.25 + 2.25 + 0.25 + 0.09 + 0.09 + 0.25) = 1.8 µGal.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sensitivity, noise budget and accuracy budget", which statement holds?
options: 原子干涉重力儀是量原子落下的時間，和落體式重力儀原理相同。
量子投影雜訊 δφ = 1/(C√N)，C = 0.5、N = 10⁵ 時 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal。
拉曼光的功率越高越好，因為脈衝越短對比越高。
optionsEn: An atom gravimeter times the atoms' fall, the same principle as a free-fall corner-cube gravimeter.
Quantum projection noise δφ = 1/(C√N) with C = 0.5 and N = 10⁵ is 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal.
More Raman power is always better because shorter pulses give higher contrast.
quiz.explanation: 量子投影雜訊 δφ = 1/(C√N)，C = 0.5、N = 10⁵ 時 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal；殘餘振動（混合修正後）10 µGal、偵測 3 µGal，每次量測合成 √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz 給 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz，平均 1000 s 後 0.25 µGal。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Quantum projection noise δφ = 1/(C√N) with C = 0.5 and N = 10⁵ is 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal; residual vibration (after hybrid correction) 10 µGal and detection 3 µGal combine to √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal per shot; at 2 Hz repetition that is 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz, averaging to 0.25 µGal after 1000 s. steps.title: 靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensitivity, noise budget and accuracy budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄連續 10⁴ 次量測並計算艾倫偏差，確認斜率 −1/2 且 1 s 的值與預算表的 7.9 µGal/√Hz 一致；在深夜地面安靜時段重做，若雜訊下降則振動項仍為主導；把原子數減半，確認雜訊只小幅上升，證明量子投影雜訊不是瓶頸。對準確度表，逐項以參數反轉（±k、±磁場、拉曼功率加倍）量出係數並更新。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record 10⁴ consecutive shots and compute the Allan deviation, confirming a −1/2 slope and a 1 s value matching the budget's 7.9 µGal/√Hz; repeat during quiet night hours, and if the noise drops the vibration term still dominates; halve the atom number and confirm only a small noise increase, proving that quantum projection noise is not the bottleneck. For the accuracy table, measure each coefficient by parameter reversal (±k, ±magnetic field, doubled Raman power) and update it. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把波前像差項憑經驗填 0.2 µGal 而未實際量測光束，實際光束因準直透鏡應力有 λ/8 的像散，造成約 6 µGal 的偏差，與落體式重力儀比對時整台儀器系統性偏高。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Entering 0.2 µGal for the wavefront term from experience without measuring the beam, while the real beam carries λ/8 of astigmatism from a stressed collimating lens, leaves a bias of about 6 µGal and the whole instrument reads systematically high against a free-fall gravimeter.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sensitivity, noise budget and accuracy budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。

optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Because the atoms fall freely in vacuum, external vibration cannot affect an atom gravimeter.
Record 10⁴ consecutive shots and compute the Allan deviation, confirming a −1/2 slope and a 1 s value matching the budget's 7.9 µGal/√Hz.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 把波前像差項憑經驗填 0.2 µGal 而未實際量測光束，實際光束因準直透鏡應力有 λ/8 的像散，造成約 6 µGal 的偏差，與落體式重力儀比對時整台儀器系統性偏高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Entering 0.2 µGal for the wavefront term from experience without measuring the beam, while the real beam carries λ/8 of astigmatism from a stressed collimating lens, leaves a bias of about 6 µGal and the whole instrument reads systematically high against a free-fall gravimeter. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩張表分開看，才不會把「穩定」誤當「準確」。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keeping the tables separate prevents mistaking stable for accurate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均時間夠長，所有誤差都會被平均掉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Given enough averaging time, every error averages away." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「系統整合：振動混合修正、時序與可運輸性」與「驗證、國際比對與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System integration: hybrid vibration correction, timing and transportability" and "Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 系統整合：振動混合修正、時序與可運輸性：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System integration: hybrid vibration correction, timing and transportability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「古典加速度計混合與序列時序」如何決定原子干涉重力儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Classical-accelerometer hybridization and sequence timing” determines the key performance of “Atomic-interferometer gravimeters”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原子干涉儀對反射鏡加速度的響應由靈敏度函數描述：在 0 到 1/(2T) 附近最敏感，更高頻率被平均掉。整合時在反射鏡上安裝低雜訊古典加速度計，記錄每次量測期間的加速度 a(t)，以靈敏度函數加權積分得到振動引起的相位，再從干涉相位中扣除或用來即時選擇讀出條紋；這種混合法把隔振平台的需求降低一個數量級，並讓儀器能在沒有安靜地基的野外工作。時序控制器以微秒精度排程裝載、釋放、三個脈衝與偵測，並把所有類比訊號同步記錄，以便事後追溯任何一次量測的狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「古典加速度計混合與序列時序」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An atom interferometer's response to mirror acceleration is described by a sensitivity function that peaks from 0 to about 1/(2T) and averages out higher frequencies. Integration mounts a low-noise classical accelerometer on the mirror, records the acceleration a(t) during each shot, integrates it weighted by the sensitivity function to obtain the vibration-induced phase, and subtracts it from the interferometer phase or uses it to choose the fringe readout in real time; this hybrid method relaxes the isolation platform by an order of magnitude and lets the instrument work in the field without a quiet foundation. A timing controller schedules loading, release, the three pulses and detection with microsecond precision and records every analogue signal synchronously so that the state of any shot can be traced afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Classical-accelerometer hybridization and sequence timing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：都市地面加速度雜訊取 1×10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz（教學假設），干涉儀有效頻寬約 1/(2T) = 5 Hz：振動相位 ≈ k_eff·T²×10⁻⁶×√5 = 1.611×10⁵×2.24×10⁻⁶ = 0.36 rad，是 10 mrad 目標的 36 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking urban ground-acceleration noise as 1×10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz (teaching assumption) and an effective interferometer bandwidth of about 1/(2T) = 5 Hz, the vibration phase is ≈ k_eff·T²×10⁻⁶×√5 = 1.611×10⁵×2.24×10⁻⁶ = 0.36 rad, 36 times the 10 mrad goal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了古典加速度計混合修正，就完全不需要隔振平台。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a classical-accelerometer hybrid correction, no isolation platform is needed at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「古典加速度計混合與序列時序」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Classical-accelerometer hybridization and sequence timing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 系統整合：振動混合修正、時序與可運輸性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System integration: hybrid vibration correction, timing and transportability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「古典加速度計混合與序列時序」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 絕對重力儀的驗證方式是與另一台原理不同的絕對儀器在同一點比對：落體式雷射干涉重力儀（如 FG5 型）用角隅稜鏡自由落體與雷射干涉量 g，兩者共享的只有地球本身。比對前要把兩台儀器的參考高度換算到同一點（垂直梯度約 −3 µGal/cm），並施加相同的潮汐、氣壓與極移修正；結果以差值與 En 值表示。國際絕對重力儀比對（ICAG）提供更大規模的驗證。交接文件包含所有偏差表、調垂與波前量測紀錄、頻率參考校正證書、以及每次搬運後的重新驗證程序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「與落體式重力儀比對及 En 值」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Before comparison the reference heights of both instruments are transferred to one point (vertical gradient about −3 µGal/cm) and identical tidal, pressure and polar-motion corrections are applied; the result is reported as a difference with an En value. International comparisons of absolute gravimeters (ICAG) provide validation at larger scale. The handoff file contains every bias table, levelling and wavefront records, the frequency-reference calibration certificate and the re-verification procedure after each transport. quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 原子重力儀是量子儀器，所以不需要與傳統重力儀比對。
原子干涉重力儀是量原子落下的時間，和落體式重力儀原理相同。
絕對重力儀的驗證方式是與另一台原理不同的絕對儀器在同一點比對：落體式雷射干涉重力儀（如 FG5 型）用角隅稜鏡自由落體與雷射干涉量 g，兩者共享的只有地球本身。
optionsEn: Being a quantum instrument, an atom gravimeter does not need comparison with classical gravimeters.
An atom gravimeter times the atoms' fall, the same principle as a free-fall corner-cube gravimeter.

An absolute gravimeter is validated by comparison with an absolute instrument of different principle at the same point: a free-fall laser-interferometer gravimeter (such as the FG5 type) measures g from a falling corner cube and laser interferometry, and the only thing the two share is the Earth itself.
quiz.explanation: 絕對重力儀的驗證方式是與另一台原理不同的絕對儀器在同一點比對：落體式雷射干涉重力儀（如 FG5 型）用角隅稜鏡自由落體與雷射干涉量 g，兩者共享的只有地球本身。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An absolute gravimeter is validated by comparison with an absolute instrument of different principle at the same point: a free-fall laser-interferometer gravimeter (such as the FG5 type) measures g from a falling corner cube and laser interferometry, and the only thing the two share is the Earth itself. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 驗證、國際比對與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「與落體式重力儀比對及 En 值」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Comparison with a free-fall gravimeter and En value” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原子重力儀讀值 g_A，落體式讀值 g_F，差 1.5 µGal；兩者擴充不確定度各 2 µGal（k = 2）。En = 1.5/√(2² + 2²) = 1.5/2.83 = 0.53 ≤ 1，比對通過。若參考高度差 10 cm 未換算，垂直梯度帶來 30 µGal 的假差異，En 升到 10.6；所以高度換算與梯度量測（以相對重力儀在兩個高度量）是比對的前置條件。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The atom gravimeter reads g_A and the free-fall instrument g_F, differing by 1.5 µGal, each with an expanded uncertainty of 2 µGal (k = 2). En = 1.5/√(2² + 2²) = 1.5/2.83 = 0.53 ≤ 1, so the comparison passes. Had a 10 cm reference-height difference gone uncorrected, the vertical gradient would create a 30 µGal false difference and En would rise to 10.6; height transfer and gradient measurement (with a relative gravimeter at two heights) are therefore prerequisites of any comparison. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一基墩上先用相對重力儀量垂直梯度，再讓兩台絕對儀器各連續量測 24 小時以上，套用相同修正模型，計算差值與 En；交接時執行一次完整的「搬運—重設—驗證」演練，記錄從到達到首筆合格數據的時間與每個檢查項目的結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the same pier first measure the vertical gradient with a relative gravimeter, then let both absolute instruments measure continuously for more than 24 hours, apply the same correction model and compute the difference and En; at handoff run a full transport, set-up and verification rehearsal, recording the time from arrival to the first qualifying datum and the result of every checklist item.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「驗證、國際比對與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 原子重力儀讀值 g_A，落體式讀值 g_F，差 1.5 µGal；兩者擴充不確定度各 2 µGal（k = 2）。
拉曼光的功率越高越好，因為脈衝越短對比越高。

steps.title: 驗證、國際比對與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「與落體式重力儀比對及 En 值」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Comparison with a free-fall gravimeter and En value” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一基墩上先用相對重力儀量垂直梯度，再讓兩台絕對儀器各連續量測 24 小時以上，套用相同修正模型，計算差值與 En；交接時執行一次完整的「搬運—重設—驗證」演練，記錄從到達到首筆合格數據的時間與每個檢查項目的結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the same pier first measure the vertical gradient with a relative gravimeter, then let both absolute instruments measure continuously for more than 24 hours, apply the same correction model and compute the difference and En; at handoff run a full transport, set-up and verification rehearsal, recording the time from arrival to the first qualifying datum and the result of every checklist item. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩台儀器用了不同的潮汐模型（一台含海洋負荷、一台不含），在沿海測站造成 5 µGal 的系統差，被解讀為原子重力儀的偏差，導致不必要的拆機重校。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using different tidal models on the two instruments (one with ocean loading, one without) at a coastal station creates a 5 µGal systematic difference that is read as a bias of the atom gravimeter and triggers an unnecessary teardown and recalibration.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一基墩上先用相對重力儀量垂直梯度，再讓兩台絕對儀器各連續量測 24 小時以上，套用相同修正模型，計算差值與 En；交接時執行一次完整的「搬運—重設—驗證」演練，記錄從到達到首筆合格數據的時間與每個檢查項目的結果。
knowledge.textEn: On the same pier first measure the vertical gradient with a relative gravimeter, then let both absolute instruments measure continuously for more than 24 hours, apply the same correction model and compute the difference and En; at handoff run a full transport, set-up and verification rehearsal, recording the time from arrival to the first qualifying datum and the result of every checklist item.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗證、國際比對與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在同一基墩上先用相對重力儀量垂直梯度，再讓兩台絕對儀器各連續量測 24 小時以上，套用相同修正模型，計算差值與 En。
平均時間夠長，所有誤差都會被平均掉。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

On the same pier first measure the vertical gradient with a relative gravimeter, then let both absolute instruments measure continuously for more than 24 hours, apply the same correction model and compute the difference and En.
Given enough averaging time, every error averages away.
quiz.explanation: 在同一基墩上先用相對重力儀量垂直梯度，再讓兩台絕對儀器各連續量測 24 小時以上，套用相同修正模型，計算差值與 En；交接時執行一次完整的「搬運—重設—驗證」演練，記錄從到達到首筆合格數據的時間與每個檢查項目的結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the same pier first measure the vertical gradient with a relative gravimeter, then let both absolute instruments measure continuously for more than 24 hours, apply the same correction model and compute the difference and En; at handoff run a full transport, set-up and verification rehearsal, recording the time from arrival to the first qualifying datum and the result of every checklist item. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗證、國際比對與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「與落體式重力儀比對及 En 值」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Comparison with a free-fall gravimeter and En value” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩台儀器用了不同的潮汐模型（一台含海洋負荷、一台不含），在沿海測站造成 5 µGal 的系統差，被解讀為原子重力儀的偏差，導致不必要的拆機重校。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using different tidal models on the two instruments (one with ocean loading, one without) at a coastal station creates a 5 µGal systematic difference that is read as a bias of the atom gravimeter and triggers an unnecessary teardown and recalibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件包含所有偏差表、調垂與波前量測紀錄、頻率參考校正證書、以及每次搬運後的重新驗證程序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff file contains every bias table, levelling and wavefront records, the frequency-reference calibration certificate and the re-verification procedure after each transport.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原子重力儀是量子儀器，所以不需要與傳統重力儀比對。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Being a quantum instrument, an atom gravimeter does not need comparison with classical gravimeters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 兩台儀器用了不同的潮汐模型（一台含海洋負荷、一台不含），在沿海測站造成 5 µGal 的系統差，被解讀為原子重力儀的偏差，導致不必要的拆機重校。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
